'''2020 TMW Finals Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Finals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open ISB Harrison-Trainor DS 2020 TM 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Finals
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
